manual.title: Go-live: flip LIVE_MODE=True
manual.description: Brier gate cleared (BS<=0.25). Steps: (1) Verify EOA sig type 0 with $1.00 test order -- confirm no "maker address not allowed" error. (2) Set LIVE_MODE=True in bot_v2.py ~line 2315, syntax-check, restart. (3) Set circuit_dry_run: false in config.json (requires restart). LIVE_APPROVAL_MODE=True gates each order via Telegram.

manual.title: Review recency_bias_shadow.jsonl at 30 flagged entries
manual.description: Count lines in data/recency_bias_shadow.jsonl where rb_signal=true. For those where mult_would>1.0: compare win_rate vs overall bot win_rate. If flagged entries win at >65% (vs ~59% base), flip rb_apply_mode: live in config.json (hot-reload, no restart). If neutral or worse, raise rb_delta_threshold from 1.5 to 2.0 and continue shadow.

auto.title: Underdispersion re-eval: 336/500 -- not yet (Jun28 review: regime artifact, kept shadow)
auto.description: Run: python3 eval_underdispersion.py (rewritten Jun 28 to use the CONTEMPORANEOUS baseline). Jun 28 verdict at n=343: +1.7pp vs same-window baseline = regime artifact, NOT a real edge; and win rate alone does not test the sigma-inflation counterfactual live mode would trigger. Kept shadow, re-gated to n=500. Only flip underdispersion_apply_mode: live if the contemporaneous edge holds >3pp at a real sample (>=40 UD rows).

auto.title: PP-sigma shadow: 2699 rows, n=336/500 -- holding (Jun28 review FAILED -0.89pp, kept shadow)
auto.description: Post-Peak Sigma Shrinkage (Feature B, data/postpeak_sigma_shadow.jsonl). Join shadow->resolved on city+date, recompute Brier pre-shrink (mu_blend_was/sigma_blend_was) vs post-shrink (mu_anchored/sigma_shrunk). Jun 28 verdict at matched n=19: -0.89pp (WORSE) -- mu-anchoring to metar_max + the 0.50 sigma floor caused blowups. Kept shadow, re-gated to n=500. If post-shrink improves Brier >2pp at the larger sample: set postpeak_apply_mode: live (hot-reload). If revisited, first try dropping the mu-anchor step and softening the sigma floor.

auto.title: Launch shadow: 616 captures (0 would-fire) -- ANALYZE now
auto.description: Fix 19/20 launch-underpricing shadow (data/launch_shadow.jsonl, status=captured). At >=30 captures: join rows to resolved.jsonl by market_id and check whether high edge_yes launches resolve YES more often than launch_ask_yes implied (the thesis). If a real edge exists, tune the Fix 20 filter (launch_capture_min_ask/min_edge/min_consensus) on the would-fire subset BEFORE considering launch_capture_enabled: true. capture_would_fire is advisory only; nothing trades until validated.
